entries.label: light_house_east_01
entries.text: It sure is quiet up at the top of this lighthouse.\nPokémon called Wattrel sometimes come here\r\nto rest their wings.

entries.label: light_house_east_02
entries.text: I saw a Rotom on the hill leading up here! A real,\nwild Rotom—not in a smartphone!

entries.label: light_house_east_03
entries.text: All this nature’s out here waiting right behind a\nbustling, modern city! It makes my hiker’s heart\r\nso happy!

entries.label: light_house_west_01
entries.text: Wow! The market looks so tiny from up above!

entries.label: light_house_west_03
entries.text: Did you cross the Asado Desert to get here as\nwell? You didn’t happen to see a kind of weird\r\nPokémon on the way here, did you?

entries.label: light_house_west_04
entries.text: Phew. I think I’ll definitely be using the Flying\nTaxi to get back to Cascarrafa.

entries.label: light_house_west_08
entries.text: I spent so much money at the auction, but I’m not\ncrying... The salty sea breeze just stings my eyes!

entries.label: light_house_north_05
entries.text: I love my Fidough! So fluffy and doughy!
